test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 17 Sept, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word in the brackets to fill in the blank.

The chef requires ______ vegetables for the salad. [stale]
solution:
The correct answer is: **Fresh**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"stale"** means something that is no longer fresh and has lost its original quality; it could refer to food that is old or no longer fit to consume. (बासी)

 
 
• **Example: **The bread had become stale after being left out for several days.
 
 
 
• **"Fresh" **refers to something that is newly made or obtained and is not old or stale; it retains its original quality and is fit for use or consumption. (ताजा)
 
 
• **Example: **The chef always prefers to use fresh ingredients to ensure the best flavor in his dishes.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'stale' **is **'fresh'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Fresh**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Green **(हरा): The color between blue and yellow in the spectrum; colored like grass or emeralds.

 
 
• **Example:** The fields were green with new grass.
 
 
 
• **Cut **(कटा हुआ): To divide something into pieces with a sharp tool.
 
 
• **Example: **He cut the vegetables into small pieces for the soup.
 
 
 
• **Leafy** (पत्तेदार): Having many leaves or much foliage.
 
 
• **Example:** The garden was filled with leafy plants and shrubs.
